comparison_notes: Exploratory chart-aligned follow-up, not a retrospective repair of the completed log-order gain study. Report every planned arm and seed, including losing or failed outcomes.

All arms have 1538 trainable parameters with identical names, registration order and initialization: gate, local_gate, history_angle, log_gain. The initial strictly-past filter is [-2,1] up to f32 rounding and all adapters start as exact identity.

Rust defines alpha=1+2*tan(angle), with domain -atan(1/2)<angle<pi/2 after f32 conversion, for every arm. The ordinary filter independently uses Torch exp/log-gain, sin/cos and shifts. Rust owns GL coefficients, gain conversion and GL/chart differentials; it is not replaced by Torch.

Domain policy is fixed before training: any chart exit stops the whole study, records arm/phase/attempted step/observed angle, forbids resume and endpoint scoring, and preserves earlier valid checkpoints. Do not clip, wrap, project, skip an arm or retune after a failure. Infrastructure interruption without a declared terminal failure remains resumable.

Primary CE contrasts: GL short minus ordinary short; GL full minus ordinary short; GL full minus GL short. K=3 and K=32 share the angular coordinate, but full-history normalization changes short taps as well as adding long taps. An advantage would not uniquely identify long-memory causation.

First losses must match exactly; initial gate-gradient norms use fixed rtol=2e-6, atol=2e-7. Preserve failed receipts. The short-filter preflight checked full tensors for eight updates only; do not assume bitwise or long-run state parity.

Complete all nine 512-update runs and eighteen continuation-only checks before endpoint scoring. Development must not select settings, duration, checkpoint or reported arms. Record angle, native order, gain and effective history-gate scale before/after every update.

Retain the preceding model, hashes, data partitions, Adam learning rate, strength and minibatch-order seeds. Reused Pride/Alice endpoints are exploratory and may appear in pretraining, not pristine confirmation. Do not pool previous runs as new independent seeds or infer significance or general LLM superiority.

CPU float32, frozen local GPT-2, full unpadded contexts and no KV cache or packed documents. History resets per block. Equal updates do not equalize arithmetic; no cross-math speed claim. Publish results, hashes and verification, not weights, corpus, native packages or private raw logs.
